richiami.difetto: Micro-cracks may form around the fuel line. As a result, fuel may leak out, increasing the risk of fire.

richiami.difetto: Possible interference between the wiring and the fuel supply line may result in damage of the fuel supply hose and subsequent fuel leaks. Fuel leakage close to a source of ignition may increase the risk of the vehicle catching fire.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Distributor · Category of measure(s): Recall of the product from end users · Date of entry into force: 26/03/2019
richiami.titolo: Possible interference between the wiring and the fuel supply line may result in damage of the fuel supply hose and subsequent fuel leaks.

richiami.difetto: Fuel leakage could occur due to insufficient connection of fuel supply pipe connector of fuel tank.
richiami.rimedio: Check and ensure correct fitment of fuel pipe connections.
richiami.titolo: INSUFFICIENT CONNECTION OF FUEL SUPPLY PIPE CONNECTOR OF THE FUEL TANK

richiami.difetto: FUEL PIPE MAY LEAK FUEL INTO THE ENGINE BAY.
richiami.rimedio: FIT EXTRA FUEL PIPE SHIELDING AND MODIFIED PIPE CLIP.
richiami.titolo: FUEL PIPE MAY LEAK FUEL INTO THE ENGINE BAY

richiami.difetto: Due to a manufacturing issue with the front lower ball joint there is a possibility that the surface of the ball joint may be damaged while driving. If the vehicle is operated continuously the ball joint may experience excessive damage and fail.
richiami.rimedio: All vehicles identified will have both front lower ball joints replaced
richiami.titolo: FRONT LOWER BALL JOINT MAY FAIL

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that some driver and front seat passenger seat backs have not been welded on both seams of the fixing bracket. In this situation should excessive weight or force be  applied to the seat back it could detach from the frame.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject welding checked at which time any missing or sub-standard welding will be rectified.
richiami.titolo: DRIVER AND PASSENGER SEAT BACKS COULD DETACH FROM THEIR FRAMES.

richiami.difetto: It has been identified that a brake pipe may chafe against the cylinder head. Should this occur there is a possibility that brake fluid will be lost from one of the two braking circuits.
richiami.rimedio: Recalled vehicles will have the subject brake pipes checked adjusted for position or replaced as necessary.
richiami.titolo: BRAKE FLUID MAY LEAK
